families.title: EOL Media Extension 1.0

core_applicability.Taxon: unsupported: preserve whole row, no orphan media

families.grain: One extension row = one media item (or text item) about the core record's taxon page.
row_rules: Archive core is dwc:Occurrence or dwc:Event and coreid resolves to exactly one emitted core record (gen-coreid-resolution).
dcterms:type is not dcmitype:Text (Text rows are taxon/text accounts: whole row goes to review, see family review_triggers).
One media row per extension row; media_pk minted (gen-weak-key-uniqueness); one occurrence-media or event-media link row to the core record with subject_basis=core_attachment.
family_review_triggers: dcterms:type is Text: route whole row to review (candidate bibliographic-resource or preserve); do not emit media.
dwc:taxonID non-empty or Iptc4xmpExt:CVterm in SPMInfoItems: media may depict the taxon generally, not this occurrence/event.
Same media identifier attached to several core records: one media row, several link rows (dedupe by mediaID only when every mapped field agrees).
catalogue_corrections: Prior target_tables ['media'] is incomplete: UsageTerms is required by the source and lands in usage-policy; bibliographicCitation/creator land in provenance; the link needs occurrence-media or event-media.

'Could follow the Audiovisual path' is wrong for dcterms:format and dcterms:language: av-media-direct-fields copies them to formatIRI/languageIRI by IRI equality, but EOL values are MIME and ISO-code literals.
audubon_core/subtype and Iptc4xmpExt:CVterm are not the IRIs of media.subtypeIRI (ac:subtype) or media.subjectCategoryIRI (ac:CVterm); they are review aliases.
eol:referenceID cannot be linked: the pinned schema has no media-reference table.

review: Text row: candidate bibliographic-resource or preserve
dwc:taxonID present: subject is a taxon

terms.source_definition: An arbitrary code that is unique for the resource, with the resource being either a media item or text description.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim to mediaID when non-empty and unique within the media table; media_pk is always minted.
review_triggers: Duplicate identifier values within the file.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: media.mediaID isVersionOf dcterms:identifier. media_pk, derivedFromMediaID, provenance_fk and usagePolicy_fk share that isVersionOf, so the field is chosen by its definition ('An identifier for an ac:Media resource'), not by IRI alone.

terms.source_definition: An identifier for the set of taxon information (data associated with the Taxon class). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Any non-empty value: the media item is a taxon-page item; its depiction of the core occurrence/event is not established.
terms.rationale: No media or link-table field holds a taxon reference; material.taxonID exists but no material is in play. Must not create identification or occurrence rows.

terms.source_definition: Any dcmi type term from http://dublincore.org/documents/dcmi-type-vocabulary/ may be used. Recommended terms are StillImage, Sound, MovingImage and Text.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
review_triggers: Value is http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/Text or 'Text' -> whole row to review (bibliographic/text account, see media.json comments).
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: media.mediaType isVersionOf dcterms:type.

terms.source_definition: Any of Drawing, Painting, Illustration, Graphic, Photograph, Map, Animation, Film, SlideShow, Diagram, Map, IdentificationKey, ScannedText, RecordedText, RecordedOrganism, TaxonPage, MultimediaLearningObject, VirtualRealityEnvironment, GlossaryPage.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: literal values from the source list (Photograph, Map, ...) -> subtypeLiteral; absolute IRIs -> subtypeIRI.
terms.rationale: NOT an exact match: source IRI is the pre-standard namespace http://rs.tdwg.org/audubon_core/subtype; media.subtypeIRI is a version of http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subtype and media.subtypeLiteral of ac:subtypeLiteral. Equivalence of the legacy namespace is an alias decision.

terms.source_definition: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as the list of Internet Media Types [MIME].
terms.value_rule: Absolute IRI (http/https/urn) -> formatIRI; any other value (e.g. 'image/jpeg', the source's own example) -> format. Never both.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI only for media.formatIRI (isVersionOf dcterms:format), but the EOL definition and example are MIME literals; media.format is the literal dc:format counterpart (isVersionOf http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/format). Note: av-media-direct-fields copies dcterms:format to formatIRI unconditionally; EOL must not reuse that rule.

terms.source_definition: Controlled vocabulary of subjects to support broad classification of media or text item. Terms from various controlled vocabularies may be used, such as the TDWG Species Profile Model (http://rs.tdwg.org/ontology/voc/SPMInfoItems) or the Plinian Core (http://www.gbif.es/plinian/doku.php). For terms from other vocabularies, a precise URI should be preferred over an unqualified term.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: absolute IRI -> subjectCategoryIRI; literal -> subjectCategory.
review_triggers: Any non-empty value; values in http://rs.tdwg.org/ontology/voc/SPMInfoItems# (the source's example) state the item is a species-profile section, which is a strong signal the row is about a taxon, not the core record.
terms.rationale: NOT an exact match: source is Iptc4xmpExt:CVterm; media.subjectCategoryIRI is a version of ac:CVterm (same gap already noted for Audiovisual in extension-catalogue.json).

terms.source_definition: Concise title, name, or brief descriptive label of the resource. This field should include the complete title with all the subtitles, if any. Detailed captions for media should be included in the description field.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: media.title isVersionOf dcterms:title.

terms.source_definition: An account of the resource. For text descriptions, the entire account should be located here. For media resources, captions should be included here. Recommended to remove all embedded HTML tags and include only plain text.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim (no HTML stripping).
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: media.description isVersionOf dcterms:description. Only reached for non-Text rows.

terms.source_definition: URI of the resource itself. If this resource can be acquired by an http request, its http URL should be given. If not, but it has some URI in another URI scheme, that may be given here.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: URL of a thumbnail image associated with the resource.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal: a second media row (accessURI = thumbnail URL, variantLiteral = 'Thumbnail', derivedFromMediaID = first row's mediaID or media_pk).
terms.rationale: No field on the same media row. A second media row is a real resource, but adding it is a modelling decision, so it needs approval.

terms.source_definition: The URL of a Web site that provides additional information about (this version of) the media resource.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: A reference to an original resource from which the current one is derived.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal: when the value equals the mediaID of another emitted media row or is an absolute IRI, copy to derivedFromMediaID.
terms.rationale: NOT an exact match: media.derivedFromMediaID isVersionOf dcterms:identifier; ac:derivedFrom is 'a reference to an original resource' and may be a citation rather than an identifier.

terms.source_definition: The date of the creation for the original resource from which the digital media was derived or created.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: Most recent date that the resource was altered.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: Language of resource itself represented in ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-3
terms.value_rule: Absolute IRI -> languageIRI; ISO 639 code or other literal (source example 'en') -> language.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI only for media.languageIRI (dcterms:language); source values are codes, which belong in the dc:language literal field media.language.

terms.source_definition: A rating of the usability of the resource, provided by users or editors, with -1 defining rejected, 0 defining unrated, and 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim (string field; -1..5 kept as text).
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: A class of entity for whom the resource is intended or useful.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No field with dcterms:audience in any pinned table (searched all 79 schemas).

terms.source_definition: The license statement defining how resources may be used. Information on a collection applies to all contained objects unless the object has a different statement.
terms.value_rule: One usage-policy row per distinct tuple (UsageTerms, dcterms:rights, xmpRights:Owner); media.usagePolicy_fk references it. Do not also copy into usage-policy.license.
review_triggers: Required by the source but empty -> report as a source validity issue; do not invent a licence.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: usage-policy.usageTerms isVersionOf xmpRights:UsageTerms.

terms.source_definition: Statement of rights associated with the resource. Creative Commons licenses require the resource to be attributed "in the manner specified by the author or licensor", and this is where that should be specified.
terms.value_rule: Absolute IRI -> rightsIRI; literal (source example 'Photo by Jane Doe') -> rights. Part of the usage-policy tuple.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI only for usage-policy.rightsIRI (dcterms:rights); usage-policy.rights is the dc:rights literal counterpart. Do not reinterpret attribution text as usage-policy.credit.

terms.source_definition: A list of the names of the owners of the copyright. 'Unknown' is an acceptable value, but 'Public Domain' is not
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim; part of the usage-policy tuple.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: A bibliographic reference for the resource. Sufficient bibliographic detail should be included to identify the resources as unambiguously as possible.
terms.value_rule: One provenance row per distinct tuple (bibliographicCitation, creator); media.provenance_fk references it.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: provenance.bibliographicCitation isVersionOf dcterms:bibliographicCitation.

terms.source_definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No media/provenance/usage-policy field is a version of dcterms:publisher (provenance.providerLiteral is ac:providerLiteral, a different concept). Same disposition as GBIF Simple Multimedia in extension-notes.md.

terms.source_definition: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No field; media-agent-role would require agent rows, and agents are never created from names.

terms.source_definition: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource. Creators of text will be considered authors; creators of photographs will be considered photographers, etc.
terms.value_rule: Literal -> provenance.creator; absolute IRI -> provenance.creatorID. Part of the provenance tuple. No agent rows.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: provenance.creator is a version of dc:creator (literal) and creatorID of dwc:agentID. Same literal/IRI split as rules av-provenance and gbif-mm-rights-provenance.

terms.source_definition: An identifier for an entity which had a role in the creation or provision of the resource. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal only when the archive also contains EOL agent rows that are converted to agent rows by an approved rule: one media-agent-role row per agentID with agentRoleOrder = position in the cell; agentRole left empty.
terms.rationale: Points to EOL Agent records (separate EOL extension, not in the audited set). media-agent-role.agent_fk and agentRoleOrder are required; the role is not stated.

terms.source_definition: The location at which the media recording instrument was placed when the media was created.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Non-empty value differing from the core event's locality.
terms.rationale: No media location field; must not be written to the core event (the instrument location is not the event location by definition).

terms.source_definition: Secondarly location field. Can be used to document the location of collection of the subject.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No field; must not be written to event.

terms.source_definition: Latitude of the location where the resource was created. Expressed on decimal WGS84 format as defined by the W3C Basic Geo Vocabulary.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Non-empty coordinates far from the core event's coordinates.
terms.rationale: Media has no coordinate fields; copying to event.decimalLatitude would assert a new location for the event.

terms.source_definition: Longitude of the location where the resource was created. Expressed on decimal WGS84 format as defined by the W3C Basic Geo Vocabulary.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As geo:lat.

terms.source_definition: Altitude of the location where the resource was created. Expressed on decimal WGS84 format as defined by the W3C Basic Geo Vocabulary.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As geo:lat.

terms.source_definition: An identifier for a related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Value matches dcterms:identifier of a row in an EOL References file in the same archive.
terms.rationale: The pinned schema has no media-reference table (searched the 79 table names), so a media-to-reference link cannot be expressed.

families.title: EOL References Extension 1.0
families.grain: One extension row = one bibliographic resource cited by the core record (or, in EOL archives, by taxa/media).
row_rules: Archive core is dwc:Occurrence or dwc:Event and coreid resolves to exactly one emitted core record.
One bibliographic-resource row per extension row (reference_pk minted), plus one occurrence-reference or event-reference row with relationshipType empty.
References reachable only through EOL media eol:referenceID (no coreid on an Occurrence/Event core) are not linked: no media-reference table exists.
family_review_triggers: Row has no resolvable coreid but its identifier is used by EOL media eol:referenceID: no linkable subject; preserve.
Same identifier attached to several core records: one bibliographic-resource, several link rows (dedupe only when every mapped field agrees).
catalogue_corrections: 'Convertible when the referencing record is convertible' is incomplete: references reached via EOL media have no target join table, so even convertible media cannot carry them.
dcterms:identifier -> referenceID, full_reference -> bibliographicCitation and publicationType -> referenceType are not IRI matches; only title, pages, volume and edition are.

extension_rows.eol:full_reference: Doe J. (2012) Birds of Oslo. Oslo Univ. Press. 210 pp.
extension_rows.dcterms:title: Birds of Oslo

terms.source_definition: An identifier for a resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by a taxon or media resource.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim when non-empty and unique within bibliographic-resource; reference_pk always minted.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: referenceID isVersionOf dwc:referenceID. Same pairing as rule gbif-reference-bibliographic; the EOL definition ('An identifier for a resource that is referenced') matches the target definition.

terms.source_definition: book, journal, journal article, webpage, etc
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy verbatim to referenceType.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: target is dwc:referenceType ('A category that best matches the nature of a dcterms:BibliographicResource'). Semantically close, but this is an alias of an EOL-namespace term.

terms.source_definition: A complete bibliographic citation describing the resource. Use of this field will cause the more specific fields here to be ignored.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: target is dcterms:bibliographicCitation. Definitions agree ('A complete bibliographic citation'), but EOL also says its presence makes structured fields be ignored; reviewers must decide whether structured fields are still copied.

terms.source_definition: Used to describe the title of a bibliographic resource.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Non-empty together with dcterms:title (article vs container title).
terms.rationale: Container (journal/book) title. bibliographic-resource.title would conflict with dcterms:title; a container record via isPartOfReferenceID would be an invented record.

terms.source_definition: Used to describe the title of an artlcle or chapter
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI: title isVersionOf dcterms:title.

terms.source_definition: A string of non-contiguous page spans that locate a Document within a Collection. Example: 23-25, 34, 54-56. For continuous page ranges, use the pageStart and pageEnd properties.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: Starting page number within a continuous page range.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal when bibo:pages is empty: pages = pageStart + '-' + pageEnd.
terms.rationale: No pageStart field; composing pages is a reformatting decision.

terms.source_definition: Ending page number within a continuous page range.
terms.value_rule: See bibo:pageStart.
terms.rationale: No pageEnd field.

terms.source_definition: A volume number.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: The name defining a special edition of a document. Normally its a literal value composed of a version number and words.
terms.value_rule: Copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI.

terms.source_definition: Used to link a bibliographic item to its publisher.
terms.value_rule: Literal -> publisher; absolute IRI -> publisherID. No agent rows.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: publisher is dc:publisher (literal) and publisherID dwc:agentID; standard dc/dcterms literal/IRI split.

terms.source_definition: An ordered list of authors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order authors by importance. Last name, first
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy verbatim (order preserved).
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: author is dc:creator. bibo:authorList is an ordered list; the target accepts a name string but separator conventions are unknown.

terms.source_definition: An ordered list of editors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order editors by importance.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy verbatim.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical: editor is bibo:editor (single property), source is bibo:editorList.

terms.source_definition: The date of the creation for the original resource from which the digital media was derived or created.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No dcterms:created field. bibliographic-resource.issued is dcterms:issued; creation is not formal issuance and the EOL definition was copied from the media extension.

terms.source_definition: Language of resource itself represented in ISO639-1 or ISO639-3.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: bibliographic-resource has no language field.

terms.source_definition: Universal Resource Identifier of a document.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No URL field; referenceID is already taken by dcterms:identifier and must not be guessed from a URI.

terms.source_definition: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for identifying the resource.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No DOI field; not substituted for referenceID.

terms.source_definition: Used to name the locality of a publisher, an author, etc.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: No place-of-publication field.

families.title: Germplasm accession (v20140515)
families.family_disposition: conditional (germplasmID only); review/preserve for the rest

core_applicability.Occurrence: conditional when the core emitted a material row

families.grain: One extension row = MCPD passport data of one genebank accession (a living material).
row_rules: Archive core is dwc:Occurrence; coreid resolves to exactly one emitted occurrence; the core emitted exactly one material row for it (basisOfRecord in the specimen classes listed in core-notes.md).
At most one Germplasm Accession row per occurrence; more than one -> review (which accession is the material?).
No material row is created by this family. Event core or no material -> every term preserved.
family_review_triggers: More than one accession row per occurrence.
basisOfRecord is not a specimen class (no material emitted).
catalogue_corrections: Prior criterion says MCPD terms 'overlapping material fields (institution, catalogue/accession number)': this XML has no institutionCode, catalogNumber or accession-number term. The only IRI-exact term is dwc:locationID, and it describes the collecting site, not the material.
Target 'material' (as a table to fill) is wrong: no material row is created and no material field receives a value; only material-identifier gets germplasmID.
storageCondition is in the germplasmType# namespace, not germplasmTerm#.

review: each preserved germplasm term: optional material-assertion proposal

terms.source_definition: A persistent identifier for a germplasm accession maintained as part of an ex situ genebank collection. Best practice is to use a globally unique and persistent identifier (PID).
terms.value_rule: One material-identifier row (identifier verbatim, identifierType empty) for the material emitted for the core occurrence. Do not overwrite material.materialEntityID.
review_triggers: material.materialEntityID empty: reviewer may promote the value to materialEntityID.
Value is an http://data.gbif.org/occurrences/ URL (source example): that identifies a GBIF occurrence, not necessarily this material.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical (no field has germplasmID as isVersionOf). material-identifier.identifier (skos:notation) holds any identifier of the material without asserting it is the primary one.

terms.source_definition: Accession name. Either a registered or other formal designation given to the accession.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal only (not automatic): one material-assertion row with assertionTypeIRI = the source term IRI and assertionValue = the value verbatim. The term IRI is a property, not a vetted measurementType vocabulary term, so a human must accept this encoding.
terms.rationale: Accession name/designation (e.g. 'Emma'); not an identifier and not a scientific or vernacular name. No field.

terms.source_definition: The biological status for a germplasm accession describes the cultivation status and distinguish wild and primitive cultivars from modern cultivars and breeding lines (material under development).
terms.source_examples: Wild; Crop wild relative (CWR); Primitive; Traditional cultivar; Landrace; Breeding line; Genetic stock; Modern cultivar; 100; 110; 120; 200; 300; 400; 410; 411; 412; 413; 414; 415; 420; 500; 999
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal only (not automatic): one material-assertion row with assertionTypeIRI = the source term IRI and assertionValue = the value verbatim. The term IRI is a property, not a vetted measurementType vocabulary term, so a human must accept this encoding.
terms.rationale: MCPD SAMPSTAT code/label. No field (extension-catalogue already notes this).

terms.source_definition: Type of germplasm storage conditions.
terms.source_examples: 10; 11; 12; 13; 20; 30; 40; 99, refer to FAO/IPGRI Genebank Standards 1994 for details on storage type.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal only (not automatic): one material-assertion row with assertionTypeIRI = the source term IRI and assertionValue = the value verbatim. The term IRI is a property, not a vetted measurementType vocabulary term, so a human must accept this encoding.
terms.rationale: MCPD STORAGE code. Note the different namespace (germplasmType#, not germplasmTerm#).

terms.source_definition: Collecting institute ID.
terms.source_examples: SWE054; urn:lsid:biocol.org:col:35293, an established institute code for the collecting/gathering institute.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: Collecting institute, not the holding institution; material.institutionID (dwc:institutionID) would be wrong. No collecting-agent field without agent rows.

terms.source_definition: Latitude of the collecting site for the source germplasm material.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
review_triggers: Differs from the core event's decimalLatitude.
terms.rationale: Collecting site of the source germplasm; not IRI-equal to dwc:decimalLatitude and must not overwrite the core event.

terms.source_definition: Longitude of the collecting site for the source germplasm material.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As geo:lat. Note 'lon' here vs 'long' in EOL Media.

terms.source_definition: Altitude of the collecting site for the source germplasm material.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: Altitude datum not stated; no elevation copy.

terms.source_definition: An identifier for the set of location information (data associated with dcterms:Location). May be a globally unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy to the core occurrence's event.locationID only when that is empty and a reviewer confirms the core event is the collecting event.
terms.rationale: Exact IRI (event.locationID isVersionOf dwc:locationID), but the definition here is the collecting site of the source material; the core event is not established as that event.

terms.source_definition: Persistent identifier for the source germplasm developed by a plant breeder.
terms.source_examples: Persistent identifier (PID) such as a URI, DOI, LSID or similar.
terms.value_rule: Default preserve. Proposal only (not automatic): one material-assertion row with assertionTypeIRI = the source term IRI and assertionValue = the value verbatim. The term IRI is a property, not a vetted measurementType vocabulary term, so a human must accept this encoding.
terms.rationale: Breeding history of the accession. No material field. Pedigrees must not become organism-relationship/resource-relationship rows: the parents are not records in the archive.

terms.source_definition: Length (m) of the short axis of the survey area. The short axis must be perpendicular to the long axis. In the case of a rectangle, this is equal to the size of the shortest side. In the case of a square or a circle, the short axis is equal to the long axis. In the case of a half circle, this is equal to the radius.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: event-assertion (unit 'm').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Orientation (decimal degrees, relative to true north) of the long axis of the survey area.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: event-assertion (unit 'degrees').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Geographic scope of the coordinates, indicating whether they represent the location of the individual sampling event, the route, or another broader geographic area.
terms.source_examples: Route (starting point), SurveyArea (centroid), County (centroid), SamplingEvent (point), SamplingEvent (centroid)
terms.value_rule: Proposal: georeferenceRemarks.
terms.rationale: Changes what the event coordinates mean (route start, county centroid). Always review.

terms.source_definition: Describes the structure of the SamplingEventIdentifier in a way that expresses the relationship between the sampling hierarchical levels (eg, for a stratified survey design, such as plots within quadrats within area or stops within routes). Ideally, the SamplingEventIdentifier should be composed in such a way to allows to identify these various sampling levels, and separating those by a dash. (eg, Route-Stop-UniqueID, or Site-Year-Month-Day).
terms.source_examples: StateProvince-Route-Stop-UniqueID, Site-UniqueID, UniqueID, Site-Year-Month-Day, Site-Year-Month-Day-SurveyID, Site-Year-Month-Day-Hour-Minutes, Site-Year-Month-Day-ObserverID
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: Describes identifier syntax; no field. Must not be used to infer parentEvent_fk.

terms.source_definition: A unique identifier for a route, transect, set of nets, or any higher organizational unit that is comprised of 1 or more SurveyAreas, traps, or nets.
terms.source_examples: Breeding Bird Survey route number, Point Count transect name, collection of mist nets
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: Higher sampling unit; creating a parent event would invent a record.

terms.source_definition: The time of day the entire observation event started (this may be different from the time when the observation represented by this single record was made), expressed as decimal hours from midnight, local time (e.g., 12. = noon, 13.5 = 1:3pm).
terms.value_rule: Proposal: convert decimal hours to hh:mm without time zone.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical; local time with no offset; values describe the whole event, not this record.

terms.source_definition: The time of day the entire observation event ended (this may be different from the time when the observation represented by this single record was made), expressed as decimal hours from midnight, local time (e.g., 12. = noon, 13.5 = 1:3pm).
terms.value_rule: With TimeObservationsStarted as an interval.
terms.rationale: As above.

terms.source_definition: The total duration of the entire observation event during which this particular observation was made, expressed as decimal hours.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: event-assertion (unit 'h').
terms.rationale: survey.eventDurationValue needs a survey.

terms.source_definition: Time (decimal hours) of the start of the interval where this observation was made, relative to the start of the entire observation event.
terms.source_examples: If the observation was done during the first 5-minute interval, TimeIntervalStarted should be .
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'h').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Time (decimal hours) of the end of the interval when this observation was made, relative to the start of the entire observation event.
terms.source_examples: If the observation was done during the first 5-minute interval, TimeIntervalEnded should be 5.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'h').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Indicates whether values in ObservationCount can be added together accross different time intervals (Yes or No). "Yes" = only new individuals are reported in each interval. "No" means = all individuals are reported within each interval.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: event-assertion.
terms.rationale: Affects summability of counts.

terms.source_definition: The total number of observers who participated in the observation event.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: event-assertion.
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: This field is used to indicate cases when no individuals (among all species targeted by the survey protocol) were detected during a sampling event (possible values: NoObs or blank). The taxon name fields for NoObs records should be left blank.
terms.value_rule: Preserve.
terms.rationale: Marks a no-detection sampling record. Must not produce occurrenceStatus='absent' for any taxon automatically.

terms.source_definition: Distance (m) between observer and organism being observed. If the distance is evaluated within a range, use DistanceFromObserverMin and DistanceFromObserverMax instead.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'm').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Minimum distance of a range (m) between the observer and the organism being observed.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'm').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Maximum distance of a range (m) between the observer and the organism being observed. Use the word "Unlimited" in cases where the range has an unlimited distance.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'm'; 'Unlimited' kept verbatim).
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Distance (m) between the point of the observation and the start of the observation event (only applicable to non-stationary censuses).
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'm').
terms.rationale: No field.

terms.source_definition: Bearing (angle in decimal degrees from  to 36) to the specimen, relative to an arbitrary bearing (e.g., north, direction of the transect or direction faced by the observer), ideally defined in the BMDR or the protocol.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion (unit 'degrees').
terms.rationale: Reference bearing is protocol-specific.

terms.source_definition: The latitude from which the individual record was collected, in cases where the main coordinates described above represent a centroid for the entire sampling event.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: Record-level position when the event coordinates are a centroid. Occurrence has no coordinates; a new event would be invented.

terms.source_definition: The longitude from which the individual record was collected, in cases where the main coordinates described above represent a centroid for the entire sampling event.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As SpecimenDecimalLatitude.

terms.source_definition: The geodetic datum to which the SpecimenDecimalLatitude and SpecimenDecimalLongitude refer. If not known, use "not recorded". This concept should be vocabulary-controlled.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As SpecimenDecimalLatitude.

terms.source_definition: The UTM zone from which the individual record was collected, in cases where the main coordinates described above represent a centroid for the entire sampling event.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As SpecimenDecimalLatitude.

terms.source_definition: The UTM northing from which the individual record was collected, in cases where the main coordinates described above represent a centroid for the entire sampling event.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As SpecimenDecimalLatitude.

terms.source_definition: The UTM easting from which the individual record was collected, in cases where the main coordinates described above represent a centroid for the entire sampling event.
terms.value_rule: Preserve verbatim.
terms.rationale: As SpecimenDecimalLatitude.

terms.source_definition: Number of individuals detected or observed during this observation event. In the case of presence/absence data, use 1 to indicate presence and indicate "Presence/Absence" under ObservationDescriptor
terms.value_rule: Apply core rule quantity.individualCount to the occurrence when the core row has no individualCount; if the core also has one, equal values discharge and different values go to review.
review_triggers: ObservationDescriptor = 'Presence/Absence' (1 means presence, not one individual) -> review, do not write 'individuals'.
terms.rationale: Exact dwc IRI; occurrence has no individualCount field (core-catalogue quantity.individualCount).

terms.source_definition: Descriptor that provides information on the type of count, the behavior or location of the individuals reported, using a standard vocabulary and/or format. Use "Total Count" if the ObservationCount field contains the total count of all records for a given species, or "Presence/Absence" if the data reflects presence absence. Distance or time intervals should be entered using this format: -1 m, >1 m, -2 min., 2-5 min., etc. Other values could include age or sex classes (Adults, Juveniles, 1st Year, After 2nd Year, Males, Females, etc.), site classes (Flyover, Outside Sampling Area, Offshore, Shoreline, Inland, etc.), behavior (Singing, Calling, Sleeping, Feeding, etc.).
terms.source_examples: TotalCount, Presence/Absence, -5 min., -1m, >1m, Offshore, Shoreline, etc.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: replaces 'individuals' when it names a count type (e.g. 'TotalCount').
terms.rationale: Qualifies individualCount; may be a distance/time band instead of a count type.

terms.source_definition: Number of individuals detected or observed during this observation event - up to 14 Counts and Descriptors can be attributed to this record.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: occurrence-assertion, assertionType = ObservationDescriptor2.
terms.rationale: Sub-count (band/interval) of the same occurrence.

terms.source_definition: Descriptor that provides information on the behavior or location of the individuals reported, using a standard vocabulary and/or format. "TotalCount" should ideally be restricted to ObservationCount only. Distance or time intervals should be entered using this format: -1 m, >1 m, -2 min., 2-5 min., etc. Other values could include age or sex classes (Adults, Juveniles, 1st Year, After 2nd Year, Males, Females, etc.), site classes (Flyover, Outside Sampling Area, Offshore, Shoreline, Inland, etc.), behavior (Singing, Calling, Sleeping, Feeding, etc.).

terms.rationale: Describes the paired count.

families.title: Extension for mapping NBN eXchange Format (NXF) files to DwC-A
families.grain: One extension row = UK vague date, grid reference and sensitivity of one record.
row_rules: Occurrence core: one NXF row per occurrence (fields describe its event). Event core: same terms describe the event.
No events are created; event fields are filled only on the event already emitted for the core record.
catalogue_corrections: Previously not term-audited. No term is IRI-exact; three terms are required by the source.

terms.source_definition: One or two character string to disambiguate UK style vague dates.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: with eventDateStart/End, eventDate = 'start/end' (or 'start' when equal) when the core eventDate is empty or consistent.
review_triggers: Code not in the NBN vague-date list.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical; required by the source.

terms.source_definition: Start of a date span for UK style vague dates.
terms.value_rule: See eventDateTypeCode.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical (dwc:eventDate).

terms.source_definition: End of a date span for UK style vague dates.
terms.value_rule: See eventDateTypeCode.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical.

terms.source_definition: The position of the occurrence as expressed against a defined grid. This grid defines both the position and precision of the location.
terms.source_examples: SD4261, a one-km square in British National Grid grid reference format.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy when empty.
review_triggers: Core coordinates conflict with the grid square.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical (dwc:verbatimCoordinates).

terms.source_definition: The grid system used for the gridReference
terms.source_examples: BNG, British National Grid; ING, Irish National Grid; UTM, Universal Transverse Mercator grid
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy (BNG/ING/UTM) when empty.
terms.rationale: Not IRI-identical (dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem).

terms.source_definition: The precision in meters along a grid square size to which the recorded grid reference is precise to. This is used where there is some uncertainty in the recorded location and overrides the precision element of the recorded grid reference.
terms.source_examples: 10000, 10km grid size (the recorded SD4261 would be considered to be SD46 for reporting and analysis purposes)
terms.value_rule: Default preserve.
terms.rationale: Grid square side length is not an uncertainty radius; conversion needs a reviewer.

terms.source_definition: The well defined key for a site boundary present on the NBN Gateway. This is used when observation recording is done to site rather than grid. NBN Gateway specific term.
terms.value_rule: Proposal: copy when locationID empty.
terms.rationale: NBN Gateway site key; not IRI-identical.

terms.source_definition: The flag for recording if an occurrence contains sensitive information that may cause environment harm if disclosed incorrectly. This is used to denote special handling and display may be required.
terms.value_rule: Preserve; reviewer writes statements.
review_triggers: Value true -> mandatory review before publication.
terms.rationale: Required boolean; no boolean sensitivity field exists and generalisation must not be invented.
